<?php
class ScopeBase237 { public function __invoke($value) { echo self::class,"/",static::class,";"; return $value; } }
class Scope237 extends ScopeBase237 { public static function launch() { global $owner; $owner->MiSsInG(((new self)(...))(true)); $owner->MiSsInG(((new parent)(...))(true)); $owner->MiSsInG(first:((new static)(...))(true)); } } class ScopeChild237 extends Scope237 { public function __invoke($value) { echo "CHILD/",static::class,";"; return $value; } }
class ScopeMagic237 { public function __call(string $name,array $arguments) { echo "HANDLER;"; return 9; } }
$owner = new ScopeMagic237; ScopeChild237::launch(); echo "AFTER;";

<?php
function shift237() { $GLOBALS["owner"] = null; echo "SHIFT;"; return false; }
class PacketBase237 { public $saved = 0; public function __construct($value) { $this->saved = $value; echo "CTOR;"; } public function __invoke($first,$ignored) { echo "INVOKE;"; return $this; } public function __destruct() { echo "PACKET;"; } }
class PacketScope237 extends PacketBase237 { public static function launch() { global $owner; return $owner->MiSsInG(((new static(7))(...))(true,shift237())); } } class PacketChild237 extends PacketScope237 {}
class Owner237 { public function __call(string $name,array $arguments) { echo "HANDLER;"; return new class($arguments) { public function __construct(public array $saved) {} public function __destruct() { echo "CHILD;"; } }; } public function __destruct() { echo "OWNER;"; } }
$owner = new Owner237; $child = PacketChild237::launch(); echo "RETURN;"; echo ($child->saved[0] instanceof PacketChild237 && $child->saved[0]->saved === 7) ? "HELD;" : "BAD;"; unset($child); echo "AFTER;";

<?php
class StopBase237 { public function __invoke() { $GLOBALS["owner"] = null; echo "INVOKE;"; throw new Exception("stop"); } public function __destruct() { echo "PACKET;"; } }
class StopScope237 extends StopBase237 { public static function launch() { global $owner; return $owner->MiSsInG(((new parent)(...))(),later237()); } } class StopChild237 extends StopScope237 {}
function later237() { echo "LATER;"; return 1; } class FailedMagic237 { public function __call(string $name,array $arguments) { echo "HANDLER;"; return 9; } public function __destruct() { echo "OWNER;"; } }
$owner = new FailedMagic237; $result = 0; try { $result = StopChild237::launch(); } catch (Exception $caught) { echo "CATCH;"; } echo $result === 0 ? "HELD;" : "BAD;";
